create_SkillPolicy_subclass: create a subclass of SkillPolicy that implements _internal_act for a custom HRL skill
implement_should_terminate: implement should_terminate in SkillPolicy to check if a skill should end based on observations
override_is_skill_done: override _is_skill_done in a SkillPolicy subclass to define custom skill completion logic
use_on_enter: use on_enter to initialize skill state and parse skill arguments when entering a new skill
select_obs_for_skill: use _select_obs to filter observations for the current skill goal in multi-object scenes
